title: Tracy Morgan gets in brutal Bronny James diss ahead of 76ers-Knicks
text:
Tracy Morgan gets in brutal Bronny James diss ahead of 76ers-Knicks NFL NBA NHL MLB WNBA Outdoors Casinos Newsletter NBA Tracy Morgan gets in brutal Bronny James diss ahead of 76ers-Knicks
 Cory Woodroof For The Win Oct. 20, 2026, 7:45 p.m. ET Comedian and actor (and notable New York Knicks fan) Tracy Morgan decided to get a pretty brutal roast in at Los Angeles Lakers guard Bronny James on Monday.
 Ahead of the Knicks hoisting the 2026 NBA championship banner and playing LeBron James' Philadelphia 76ers , Morgan decided to troll Bronny James with a tough one-liner.
 "Bronny look like he got JUCO ball written all over him," Morgan quipped during the NBC Sports pregame show.
 Ouch. We're sure that LeBron and Bronny will get wind of this Morgan insult sooner than later. If LeBron James gives a Morgan diss any time in the future, you'll know why.
 Well, it's just more bulletin board material for the James family!
 Is Bronny still with the Lakers?
 As of now, he's still with the organization.
